org.apache.camel.quarkus.core.CamelConfi.description: When set to true, the {@link CamelRuntime} will be started automatically.
What to do if it is not possible to extract CSimple expressions from a route definition at build time.

Ant-path style patterns, as described in link:https://example.org/patterns[the patterns guide]:

[source,properties]
----
quarkus.camel.service.discovery.include-patterns = META-INF/services/org/apache/camel/foo/++*++
----
